content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(KOI-002 MCP Tool Response Embeds Instruction Injection And Credential Exfil String) OR XQL(KOI-002 MCP Runtime Monitor Instruction Shaped String In Tool Result) OR XQL(KOI-002 AIRS Indirect Injection Scorer On MCP Result In Prompt) — stitched by shared agent_hostname + causality_id so the code-scan finding, the runtime tool-result consumption, and the AIRS indirect-injection detection (shared_entity: the same tainted result) collapse into ONE agentic-supply-chain incident
rules.name: Agentic Supply Chain — MCP Tool-Response Indirect Injection
